schedule.rationale: Five small collect-fit blocks exercise publication at initial and fifth/final update; they are a pipeline diagnostic, not enough data to select a competitive policy.
schedule.alternatives: Larger budgets require user-run timing and score evidence before selection.
schedule.uncertainty: No training quality or throughput is predicted.

model.rationale: Retain the existing small shared GRU and entity pooling; add public score and identity/rank so teacher-dependent distinctions are observable. Legacy width remains an ablation.
model.alternatives: Feedforward versus GRU, pooling versus attention, public context off, hidden widths measured on the target allocation.
model.uncertainty: Memory fit and teacher imitation fidelity require a user-launched pilot.

optimizer.rationale: Existing Adam learning rate and gradient limit are a small-update starting hypothesis, not mathematically optimal values; inspect gradient norms and policy KL.
optimizer.units: learning rate and gradient L2 norm
optimizer.alternatives: Compare smaller/larger rates under matched collected transitions.
optimizer.uncertainty: No target-task sensitivity evidence is claimed.

ppo.rationale: Undiscounted team score motivates gamma=1. One epoch and short BPTT bound the diagnostic. A fixed divisor5 scales the actor relative to the initial team, not by current population. Scratch PPO disables teacher regularization.
ppo.units: probabilities, ratios, loss weights, decision ticks
ppo.alternatives: Measure longer trace/chunks, clipping and loss coefficients; warm-start regularization is a separate explicitly configured ablation.
ppo.uncertainty: GAE and chunk horizons are derived in preflight; they are not a proof of sufficient long-term credit.

imitation.rationale: Start with teacher-only BC and one fit epoch per update; bound FIFO replay. Enable DAgger explicitly only after examining the BC curve and teacher labels.
imitation.units: epochs, mixture probability, rounds, team frames
imitation.alternatives: User-launched DAgger rounds and more epochs after the initial supervised sanity check.
imitation.uncertainty: Loss improvement does not imply improved native episode score.

resources.rationale: One CPU environment and the existing conservative memory cap are a diagnostic starting point even on80GB hardware; do not fill an accelerator before measuring memory and CPU throughput. Cadence1 matches serving.
resources.units: workers, threads, MiB, tokens, seconds, native ticks per action
resources.alternatives: Increase workers/tokens/memory after user-run A100 or H100 workload measurements.
resources.uncertainty: Allocation-specific limits and native-thread overhead must be measured.

evaluation.rationale: Use initial and every5completedupdates plus final full episodes on the existing three-world quick development suite. Bound snapshot size and pending queue; budget includes the teacher reference.
evaluation.alternatives: Adjust cadence/repeats before a run after measuring evaluator cost and variance; reserve holdout.
evaluation.uncertainty: Three seeds give a noisy development curve, not a statistical claim of superiority.
